subject: R1 adversarial analysis finds P0 confident-wrong parser/optimizer cases
summary: Following Manager-02 deconfliction, 5f9d stayed on the code/schema/parser/optimizer sublane. The v2 adversarial analysis identifies four P0 classes: per-visit dollar caps can be promoted into annual maximums; combined pools/per-practitioner caps are collapsed; maximum-eligible-expense limits are treated as insurer-payment ceilings; and waiting periods are ignored while rules can still become high confidence. A Canada Life PSHCP-style example causes the current optimizer representation to estimate $480 insurer payment where the documented plan example caps annual reimbursement at $400. A proposed red-test skeleton is included as research-only evidence.
requested_action: Manager review under RESEARCH_REVIEW_CONTRACT_V1.md; if supported, recommend Primary classify current flat maximum_amount semantics as synthetic-beta-only and adopt typed limit basis/scope plus eligibility-gate red tests as P0 hardening criteria.
evidence_sources: Sun Life Health Coverage Choice / Personal Health product pages
Pacific Blue Cross Understanding Reasonable and Customary Limits
privacy_security: No member IDs, plan IDs, credentials, claim numbers, or real user plan data were used. Fixtures are synthetic/public-plan examples.
